review.semantic_boundary:
The task can retain its public contract. Internal cache representation is not prescribed.

Prompt windows and masked multimodal items -> production request/cache accounting,
scheduler admission and full-item budget, registry/profiler capacity, real
GPUModelRunner._execute_mm_encoder cache writes followed by real
GPUModelRunner._gather_mm_embeddings -> embedding-row allocation/budget and
correct selected embedding values in prompt order.

The encoder model and media-input grouping produce deterministic, contract-valid
embedding tensors. Their weights/media preprocessing do not determine the
accounting or cache-layout transition. These producers are substituted only in
verifier/challenge code. Cache writes, scatter, cache reads and gather execute
candidate production code. No cache tensor is installed by the fixture.
GPU execution is not semantic to this coordinate/accounting task; normal CPU
PyTorch executes these production transitions. Serving/model-tokenizer resources
are outside this boundary and are not supplied as curator reproducer assets.

The mapping checks cover 15 sparse windows plus all 136 nonempty windows across
three ordered sparse/dense/all-false items, including prompt gaps and cross-item
windows. The independent challenge uses another offset/mask and six windows.
The historical model_runner_compact_gather stage name describes compact encoder
outputs; it does not constrain cache storage. The parent still requires every
stage and its expected observation to complete.

A complete correct control keeps the original dense cache writer/reader together
while fixing accounting, scheduling and profiler paths. The Oracle uses compact
storage. Reversing encoder rows before cache storage is an incorrect control.
No physical-memory claim is inferred merely from accounting or cache shape.

Final run outcomes are recorded in e2e-evidence.json after validation. Earlier
raw scores and pre-repair evidence remain historical and are not overwritten.
review.attribution: Two previous mapping failures were fixture-induced. Latest solver replay now passes both mapping groups but still fails profiling and budget checks.
review.decision: Execute production encoder cache writes before production gather; accept compact and dense representations; reject corrupted encoder order.
